articles.title: SIR, Form 6, Voter Rolls: EC Responds After Report Flags Objections By 2 Election Commissioners
articles.description: The Election Commission has rejected reports of differences among its members over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, saying all decisions were taken unanimously. The Indian Express reported that Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had raised objections on several issues, including voter registration, deletion and restoration of names, electoral data access and the handling of appeals. The report also highlighted concerns over changes to Form 6, access to the ERO Net database, pending appeals in West Bengal and a software-related issue involving 97 voters in Goa. The EC acknowledged that the two Commissioners had raised concerns over certain aspects of the exercise but said these did not amount to disagreement with final decisions. It maintained that all SIR-related decisions had the approval of all three Commissioners.

articles.title: 'Why Not Give New Jersey To Israel?': Trump Ally Humiliates Him In His Own Home Over Golan Capture
articles.description: Syrian President Ahmad al-Sharaa recalled a joke he made to U.S. President Donald Trump during his White House visit over the disputed Golan Heights. Al-Sharaa said that when Trump stated the Golan Heights belongs to Israel, he jokingly suggested giving New Jersey to Israel instead, arguing that Trump does not own the Golan Heights to give away.Al-Sharaa stressed that, joke aside, he believes the Golan Heights belongs to its own people and cannot be abandoned or transferred by the Syrian or U.S. president. His remarks highlight the continuing dispute over the Golan Heights and the wider tensions surrounding Syria, Israel and U.S. policy in the region.
